intuition.title: Seed enlargement has a finite useful range
intuition.text: One additional precursor injection increases a reported 4.0 nm seed population to 6.2 nm. More than two added injections gives about 10 nm irregular, polydisperse polycrystalline particles. The main SI declaration names three additions, but the SI itself is unreviewed. The 7.2 nm diffraction inset label is not assigned to an invented two-addition recipe.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2–4, 6, Additional injections and SI declaration

intuition.title: Alloy assignment and the remaining alternative
intuition.text: ICP-AES and EDX report an approximately 1:3 Co/Pt ratio across the preparations. XRD and HRTEM support chemically disordered fcc CoPt3. The authors explicitly note that diffraction alone cannot completely exclude phase segregation or a core–shell model, then argue against those alternatives using TEM contrast and composition behavior. No measured atomic coordinates, ordered L12 cell or core–shell interface is asserted.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
